messages:
Alex: Heads-up — dashboard alert: tool-response validation errors spiked and pushed several customers into quota-fallback routing. Saw bursts around 13:02 UTC. :eyes:
Maria: Which validation errors? structured output rejects or adapter failures?
Alex: Mostly structured output rejects. Console shows a cluster of `validation.reject` events with reason 'invalid_enum' and 'missing_field'.
Jamie: Huh. I thought we tag those as nonfatal and don't count against quota. Are they being counted as failures in the quota pipeline?
Priya: Noted. UX around rollouts is confusing — if we mark strict validation on a canary, users see quota bump + fallback to smaller model. That happened for two accounts.
SRE-Bot: incident created: INC-2026-1045 — routing fallback due to validation spikes. Pager muted.
DevOps: Can you paste a sample of the log payload? need to see the exact shape we feed into telemetry.
Alex: Pasted below (redacted):
```
{"request_id":"req_7a9b","model":"xg-lite-v2","route":"primary","validation":{
  "status":"rejected",
  "reason":"missing_field",
  "schema":"tool_call_response_v1",
  "path":"/tool_result/code"
},"router_action":"fallback_to_compatible","quota_charge":1}
```
Jamie: That `quota_charge:1` is the kicker. We increment quota for structured rejects in the billing pipeline. That was by design for strict enforcement, but we recently enabled soft-validate slightly wrong for this model.
Maria: So config drift: canary config said soft-validate=true but the runtime flagged it as strict because of a legacy toggle?
Priya: Exactly. The rollout UI shows the canary as soft, but the runtime reads `validate_level` from route metadata which we forgot to sync.
DevOps: Quick mitigation options? patch the router to not attach `quota_charge` for rejects when route.meta.validate_level=="soft"
Jamie: We can implement a 1-line guard in router: `if (route.meta.validate_level==='soft') event.quota_charge = 0` — but need tests + deploy.
Alex: Short-term: can we add an alert rule to surface `validation.rejects where quota_charge>0 and route.meta.validate_level=='soft'` and mute the automation to avoid more customer-facing routing changes?
SRE-Bot: Alert rule created: "soft-validate quota mismatch" (muted automation).
Maria: Also adding a telemetry tag would help for postmortem — `validation.enforcement_source` = runtime|router|console.
Jamie: Agree. That lets us differentiate console-config mismatches vs runtime defaults.
Priya: For product: we should change console copy — make rollout validation toggle show effective runtime value and warn if mismatch.
DevOps: I'll draft the quick router patch and a unit test. ETA ~2h. Anyone want to pair on the test?
Alex: I'll help with the test vectors — can throw in cases with `invalid_enum` and nested missing fields.
Maria: For the postmortem, capture impacted accounts and whether fallback used smaller model (cost/latency delta). Add chart on quota spikes vs validation rejects. Link: https://console.internal/redwood/alerts/INC-2026-1045
Jamie: Follow-ups: (1) telemetry tag `validation.enforcement_source`, (2) router guard to skip quota charge for soft, (3) console UX copy + effective-value flag, (4) postmortem.
Priya: I'll own console UX. Jamie + DevOps own router + telemetry. Alex + Maria own postmortem inventory.
SRE-Bot: Update: mitigation patch deployed to staging. Observability dashboards updated to include the new tag.
DevOps: Patch merged to main; rolling to prod with canary.
Alex: Thanks all. Keeping thread open for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
